kv18.2:1.6: Abhinimmito Jino Satthā Sammāsambuddho Sabbaññū Sabbadassāvī Dhammasāmī Dhammapaṭisaraṇo ti?
kv18.2:2.6: Āyasmā Ānando Jino Satthā --pe-- Dhammapaṭisaraṇo ti?
kv18.2:3.5: "Saṃkhittena pi kho ahaṃ Sāriputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
kv18.2:3.6: vitthārena pi kho ahaṃ Sāriputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
kv18.2:3.7: saṃkhittavitthārena pi kho ahaṃ Sāriputta dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
kv18.2:3.11: Tena hi Buddhena Bhagavatā Dhammo desito ti. 4.
kv18.2:4.6: sanidānāhaṃ Bhikkhave Dhammaṃ desemi no anidānaṃ,
kv18.2:4.7: sappāṭihāriyāhaṃ Bhikkhave Dhammaṃ desemi no appāṭihāriyaṃ,
kv18.2:4.8: yañ c' assa mayhaṃ Bhikkhave abhiññāya Dhammaṃ desayato no anabhiññāya, sanidānaṃ Dhammaṃ desayato no anidānaṃ, sapāṭihāriyaṃ Dhammaṃ desayato no appāṭihāriyaṃ karaṇīyo ovādo karaṇīyo anusāsanī,
kv18.2:4.9: alañ ca pana vo Bhikkhave tuṭṭhiyā, alaṃ attamanatāya, alaṃ somanassāya
kv18.2:4.10: Sammāsambuddho Bhagavā, svākhyāto Dhammo suppaṭipanno Saṃgho ti.
kv18.2:4.11: Imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne dasasahassī lokadhātu akampitthā ti."
kv18.2:4.14: Tena hi Buddhena Bhagavatā Dhammo desito ti
